description: This file contains unit tests for the PayGradeAPI class, which is an API endpoint in the OrangeHRM system related to managing pay grades within the admin module. It utilizes a testing framework with mock services and data providers to verify API functionality such as getAll, getOne, create, update, and delete operations.

classes.name: PayGradeAPITest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the PayGradeAPI REST endpoints, including CRUD operations, within the OrangeHRM HR management system.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test environment, clears relevant data tables, and loads test fixtures.

methods.name: testGetAll
methods.description: Tests the 'getAll' method of the PayGradeAPI endpoint using data-driven test cases.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestGetAll
methods.description: Provides test case data for the 'testGetAll' method from a YAML file.

methods.name: testGetOne
methods.description: Tests retrieving a single pay grade via the 'getOne' API method.

methods.name: testCreate
methods.description: Tests creating a new pay grade through the API.

methods.name: testUpdate
methods.description: Tests updating an existing pay grade via the API.

methods.name: testDelete
methods.description: Tests deleting a pay grade via the API.
